articles.title: Education & Society 教育与社会
articles.summary: Technology in classrooms, tuition fees and the future of learning.

sentences.orig: The debate over the role of technology in classrooms has intensified, with proponents praising personalised learning and critics citing distraction.
sentences.trans: 关于技术在课堂中作用的争论愈演愈烈，支持者称赞个性化学习，批评者则指出分心问题。

sentences.orig: University tuition fees have risen sharply over the past decade, placing an increasing financial burden on students and families.
sentences.trans: 过去十年大学学费大幅上涨，给学生和家庭带来了日益沉重的经济负担。

sentences.orig: Governments are investing heavily in vocational training to bridge the widening skills gap in the labour market.
sentences.trans: 各国政府大力投资职业培训，以弥合劳动力市场日益扩大的技能差距。

sentences.orig: Research suggests that early childhood education has a profound and lasting impact on cognitive development.
sentences.trans: 研究表明，幼儿教育对认知发展具有深远而持久的影响。

sentences.orig: The digital divide remains a formidable barrier, preventing millions of students from accessing quality education.
sentences.trans: 数字鸿沟仍然是一道难以逾越的障碍，使数百万学生无法获得优质教育。

sentences.orig: Educators advocate a shift away from rote memorisation towards critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
sentences.trans: 教育工作者主张从死记硬背转向批判性思维和解决问题能力的培养。

sentences.orig: Lifelong learning has become a necessity in a rapidly evolving job market, where skills become obsolete within a decade.
sentences.trans: 在技能十年内就会过时的快速变化就业市场中，终身学习已成为必要。

sentences.orig: Policymakers face the challenge of balancing academic excellence with equitable access to educational opportunities.
sentences.trans: 政策制定者面临在学术卓越与教育机会公平之间取得平衡的挑战。
